title: Senior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Writer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Writer (Roteirista)

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.


Role Overview

As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.


Key Responsibilities

1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy

  • Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
  • Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
  • Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.

2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight

  • Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
  • Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
  • Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
  • Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.

3. Team Management & Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
  • Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
  • Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
  • Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.

4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
  • Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
  • Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.

5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control

  • Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
  • Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
  • Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.

6. User-Centric Content Improvement

  • Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
  • Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
  • Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
  • Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
  • Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.

8. Promotion & Growth Strategy

  • Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
  • Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
  • Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
  • Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Key Traits for Success

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
  • Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
  • Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
  • Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
  • Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

title: AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The role

We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.


Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.


What you’ll bring

  • Advanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese.
  • Fluency in English (B2+)
  • A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant pool
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a time
  • A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer
  • A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed
  • A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients


What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese
  • Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts
  • Improving cutting-edge AI models


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on us every weekend.

  • Strong backend fundamentals, systems-first mindset

  • Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality



Tech stack


  • Backend: NestJS (Node.js), TypeScript
  • Infra: AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare
  • Data: Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)
  • Frontend: Next.js, Expo (React Native)
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions



Nice to have


  • Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces
  • Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience
  • Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration)

  • React Native or Expo

O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

Automação e integração (desejável):

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Development Representative - Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)

  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Data Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nosso time de Dados

Nosso time de dados é responsável por empoderar as equipes da Nuvemshop para tomarem as melhores decisões, transformando dados em acionáveis. Trabalhamos em colaboração para ajudar a criar uma cultura de trabalho apoiada em dados, que lhes permite atingir seus objetivos de forma eficiente, fornecendo a infraestrutura e as ferramentas necessárias para apoiar essas equipes.


O tamanho do seu desafio

  • Ser ponto focal da equipe de Analytics para Finance, atuando como referência técnica e estratégica na identificação proativa de problemas de negócio;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e a manutenção de modelos financeiros e análises preditivas que suportem decisões estratégicas de receita, custos e investimentos;
  • Implementar as melhores práticas de visualização de dados para criar insights significativos e torná-los acionáveis;
  • Construir soluções com novas métricas e painéis de controle que ajudem as equipes de Finance a tomarem as melhores decisões;
  • Conduzir análises de variância (real vs. orçado) e identificar oportunidades de otimização de custos e melhoria de margens;
  • Encontrar 80/20s que possam maximizar o ROI do que fazemos;
  • Encontrar correlações entre diferentes ações e resultados financeiros com foco em rentabilidade, fluxo de caixa e eficiência operacional;
  • Automatizar processos de reporting financeiro e reduzir dependência de análises manuais, propondo soluções escaláveis;
  • Melhorar o que entendemos sobre o negócio para desbloquear novas possibilidades.


O que buscamos

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL;
  • Experiência em DBT para modelagem de dados;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (preferencialmente Tableau);
  • Experiência trabalhando com equipes financeiras, com entendimento aprofundado de conceitos como P&L, forecast, budget, unit economics e análise de variância;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de FP&A ou ERPs;
  • Base sólida em estatística descritiva e modelagem financeira;
  • Capacidade de abstrair e focar em informações/fatos relevantes em uma ampla gama de dados;
  • Habilidade comprovada de influenciar stakeholders e traduzir dados complexos em recomendações claras e acionáveis para liderança;

  • Excelentes habilidades de relacionamento, colaboração e planejamento.


São diferenciais

  • Conhecimento de Python para análise;
  • Experiência aplicando inteligência artificial generativa (GenAI) para acelerar análises de dados, automação de workflows ou geração de insights;
  • Experiência em e-commerce ou empresas de tecnologia SaaS.


Nosso processo

Queremos que você tenha a melhor experiência possível ao longo do nosso processo seletivo. Após a sua inscrição, o time de Talent Acquisition irá analisar seu perfil com atenção e, independentemente do resultado, você receberá um retorno. As etapas e prazos podem variar de acordo com cada vaga, mas não se preocupe — que nos manteremos em contato com você.


O que temos para você

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.


What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.


Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Analista BIM - Coordenação de Modelos Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista BIM - Coordenação de Modelos Pleno em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar com implementação BIM e estruturação de ambiente colaborativo em projetos industriais, com foco em engenharia multidisciplinar e transformação digital .

Se você tem experiência com coordenação BIM, design review e gosta de estruturar processos, essa vaga é pra você.


  • Implantar e configurar o Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) em empresas do setor industrial;

  • Garantir aderência a normas, templates e padrões BIM da empresa.


Requisitos

  • Formação em Engenharia ou áreas correlatas (ou técnico);
  • Experiência com BIM colaborativo e coordenação de projetos multidisciplinares ;

  • Conhecimento em conceitos BIM (parâmetros, famílias, coordenação, compatibilização);

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a full-time, remote Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of C# and 2+ years of modern JavaScript framework experience, such as React.js, Angular, or Vue.js, to join the software engineering team of our U.S. client. The right candidate must have a passion for building seriously cool technology, delivering on time, utilizing industry best practices, and working in a fast-paced environment.


Our client is on a mission to make people more productive by providing cloud-based, document management and file sharing solutions that automate routine, repetitive tasks. They are a subsidiary of a publicly traded company that trades on the London Stock Exchange. With hundreds of thousands of users already onboard today, our client is in growth mode, building new products to serve the U.S., the United Kingdom, and Australia / New Zealand markets.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop robust, high-quality, front- and back-end product features
  • Develop integrations using external and internal APIs
  • Apply good development practices following team standards, and look for opportunities to improve and innovate
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Assist the development team in troubleshooting
  • Collaborate with leadership, product management, and other key stakeholders on building a product that wins market share
  • Deliver high-quality code with velocity and provide work estimates based on task complexity
  • Exercise a bias towards action, but understand when to pause and reflect
  • Take pride and interest in your work
  • Work independently with minimal need for oversight, as well as display a willingness to ask questions when needed to remain efficient


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 3+ years of software development experience using C#
  • 2+ years of experience working with JavaScript frameworks, such as React.js, Angular, or Vue.js
  • Strong front-end skills with proficiency in HTML, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, and AJAX
  • Experience building modern web applications and working with RDBMS, such as MySQL
  • Experience leading a project providing subject matter expertise on personally researched and designed features to colleagues for implementation
  • Background building and consuming REST services
  • Ability and eagerness to learn new skills quickly
  • Solid understanding of programming fundamentals
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Desire to make things better and foster good development practices
  • Background working with designers and within an Agile team
  • Ability to work within coding guidelines
  • Exposure to SaaS software design, development, deployment, and maintenance
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Track record building professional, high-quality, and on-time software


Desired Experience:

  • Experience working with cloud platforms: AWS and Azure
  • Experience in SaaS architecture and design
  • Background in responsive web design
  • Experience in automated testing, TDD, and BDD
  • Experience working with one or more of the following: Entity Framework (or another ORM framework), ElasticSearch, RabbitMQ, CouchBase, Scala, and OAuth 2.0
  • Familiarity with WinForms application development


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient:

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos, workshops e palestras (principalmente em espanhol) sobre GCP;

  • Apoiar clientes na adoção de soluções de modernização de aplicações e infraestrutura;

Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform (GCP);
  • Experiência em arquitetura de soluções em cloud e desenho de soluções escaláveis;
  • Vivência com modernização de aplicações e arquiteturas cloud-native e serverless;
  • Experiência com serviços GCP como Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud Monitoring e Cloud Logging;
  • Experiência com containers e orquestração, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes / Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE);
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC), especialmente com Terraform;

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de APIs via Apigee;
  • Vivência com Enterprise Scheduler Service;
  • Experiência com Anthos;
  • Conhecimento em Cloud SQL e Memorystore;
  • Experiência com AI/ML na GCP, incluindo Vertex AI;
  • Conhecimento em Looker;
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Vivência com GitOps, incluindo ArgoCD;
  • Conhecimento em Istio;
  • Experiência com FinOps;
  • Práticas de SRE (Site Reliability Engineering);
  • Conhecimento em segurança em cloud (Security Best Practices).

description:

What You’ll Gain

  • Exposure to real-world technology projects
  • Mentorship from experienced professionals
  • Opportunity to develop communication, leadership, and organizational skills

Skills

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Investment Banking Intern em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;

  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack

  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)

description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

REMOTO

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

title: Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing.

You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle.
  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications.
  • System Optimization: Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems.
  • Complex Integrations: Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.
  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.

description:

Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

title: Data Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Software Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 20-25/hr USD.


Role Details:


We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties.
  • Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services.
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores.
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management.
  • Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.


Qualifications: What you bring to the team


You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences.
  • Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js.
  • Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services.
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps).
  • Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility.
  • BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.


You might also have:

  • Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience.
  • AWS Certifications.
  • Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus).
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation.
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture.
  • Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring.
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming.

Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.



Position Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.



What You'll Do:


  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.



What You Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Analista Data Viz Sr.
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Data Viz Sr. em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Esse(a) profissional será responsável por transformar dados em narrativas visuais claras, eficientes e orientadas ao negócio, indo além da construção de dashboards e garantindo que toda a jornada dos dados — desde as camadas analíticas até a visualização — seja confiável, performática e escalável.


O desafio envolve atuar com grandes volumes de dados em ambientes cloud, estruturando e preparando dados nas camadas analíticas (especialmente Silver e Gold), organizando métricas e regras de negócio, e construindo visualizações que realmente gerem valor para as áreas.


Buscamos alguém com forte pensamento analítico, domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados e experiência prática na preparação e modelagem de dados para consumo em BI. Mais do que dominar ferramentas específicas, esperamos alguém que entenda profundamente como dados se transformam em informação e decisão.


Como Analista de Data Visualization Sênior, você atuará em conjunto com times multidisciplinares, sendo a ponte entre dados e negócio, garantindo que as soluções analíticas sejam compreensíveis, confiáveis e acionáveis.


Se você gosta de contar histórias com dados, estruturar informações de forma inteligente e atuar próximo ao negócio para gerar impacto real, essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver dashboards e produtos de dados focados em geração de insights e suporte à tomada de decisão.Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções visuais claras, intuitivas e eficientes.Atuar na preparação e transformação de dados nas camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold), garantindo qualidade e consistência.Modelar dados para consumo em ferramentas de BI, aplicando boas práticas de performance e escalabilidade.Definir e organizar métricas e KPIs em conjunto com as áreas de negócio, promovendo padronização.Aplicar princípios de Data Visualization (design, storytelling, hierarquia de informação, UX analítica).Otimizar dashboards e queries visando melhor performance e experiência do usuário.Garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas visualizações por meio de validações e consistência lógica.Trabalhar em parceria com Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers e áreas de negócio.Documentar dashboards, métricas e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.Apoiar na definição de boas práticas de visualização, modelagem e consumo de dados.Contribuir para a evolução da cultura data-driven na organização.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência sólida com Data Visualization, BI ou Analytics.Domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados (storytelling, design, percepção visual, UX).Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI, Tableau e Looker .Conhecimento em modelagem de dados para consumo analítico.Domínio em SQL para exploração, transformação e validação de dados.Experiência com preparação de dados (ETL/ELT), especialmente em camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold).Conhecimento em linguagens das ferramentas de BI, como DAX e Linguagem M (Power BI).Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud e conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou Lakehouse.Capacidade de entender regras de negócio e traduzi-las em métricas e visualizações.Experiência com otimização de queries e performance de dashboards.Boa comunicação para interação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Requisitos desejáveis

Experiência com Python aplicado a análise e visualização de dados.


Conhecimento em frameworks de visualização interativa como Streamlit.


Experiência com construção de produtos de dados além de dashboards (apps analíticos, data products).


Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e ambientes distribuídos.


Conhecimento em versionamento de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Experiência com testes e validação de dados.


Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;

100% remoto;

Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura;

description:

About Us

We are a performance driven YouTube ad creative agency focused on producing high converting video ads for ecommerce brands.

Our team combines direct response strategy with cutting edge AI production workflows to create scalable video assets that drive measurable results.

We move fast, test aggressively, and continuously iterate on creative performance. Our focus is not on aesthetics alone, but on producing video content that converts and scales profitably.

Craft high quality prompts for VEO3, Kling, Heygen, and similar AI video tools to generate compelling video clips.

Produce raw video footage that aligns with creative briefs and direct response messaging.

Iterate on AI generated outputs to refine quality, consistency, and performance.

Stay up to date with the latest AI video tools, prompting techniques, and workflows.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality.

Optimize workflows to increase output efficiency and scalability.

Experience using AI video tools such as VEO, Kling, Heygen, Runway, or similar.

Strong prompting ability with a clear understanding of how to control output quality and style.

Good visual sense and understanding of storytelling, pacing, and scene composition.

Ability to follow creative briefs and translate them into accurate visual outputs.

Experience working in a fast paced, performance driven environment.

Highly self directed with strong attention to detail.

Experience producing video creatives for YouTube or paid social ads.

Experience working with ecommerce brands.

Familiarity with AI workflow automation and tools.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staff Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor.


Perfil desejado

Buscamos uma liderança técnica com alta autonomia e visão sistêmica. Você não apenas escreve código de excelência, mas atua como um multiplicador, influenciando o roadmap técnico e garantindo que nossas soluções sejam resilientes e seguras por padrão.

Você deve ser um entusiasta da eficiência, utilizando ferramentas de IA e agentes para acelerar o ciclo de desenvolvimento, permitindo que seu foco esteja na resolução de problemas complexos de arquitetura e estratégia de dados.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderança de Arquitetura: Guiar a concepção e evolução da plataforma Audit Copilot, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e rastreabilidade em todo o ecossistema.
  • Impacto Cross-Team: Atuar além do próprio time, identificando dependências, mitigando riscos técnicos e garantindo que as integrações com os times de Dados sejam fluidas e performáticas.
  • Excelência Operacional: Definir e zelar por padrões de confiabilidade (SLOs) e observabilidade, transformando aprendizados de incidentes em melhorias sistêmicas para reduzir o toil.
  • Mentoria e Cultura: Elevar a barra técnica da Arvo, mentorando engenheiros, promovendo revisões de design críticas e disseminando boas práticas (TDD, CI/CD, Clean Architecture).
  • Parceria Estratégica: Colaborar com Produto para refinar o escopo técnico de iniciativas ambíguas, equilibrando trade-offs entre velocidade de entrega e dívida técnica.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em engenharia de computação ou ciência da computação ou possuir experiência prática nessas áreas
  • 7+ anos de experiência com desenvolvimento e arquitetura de software
  • Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura e boas práticas de código tais como SOLID, Clean Code Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, Layered Architecture, etc.
  • Experiência com algum cloud provider (GCP, AWS, Azure, etc.)
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Postgres) e não relacionais (Redis)
  • Uso de ferramentas e agentes de IA (ex: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, LLMs para automação) para agilizar a codificação, testes e documentação.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência com pipeline de processamento de dados
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Go e Python
  • Experiência com terraform e IaC, Kubernetes (recursos básicos, kubectl)
  • Experiência com GCP


Benefícios (modelo de contratação PJ)

  • 13º salário: proporcional aos meses trabalhados no ano
  • Férias remuneradas: 22 dias úteis
  • 1/3 adicional de férias
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco Saúde Nacional II (TNMI)
  • VA/VR: R$1.080 no Flash
  • Acesso ao wellhub (gympass)
  • Vaga remota

Confira esta oportunidade para AI Video Producer (VEO3) for YouTube Ad Creative Agency em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

We are a performance driven YouTube ad creative agency focused on producing high converting video ads for ecommerce brands.

Our team combines direct response strategy with cutting edge AI production workflows to create scalable video assets that drive measurable results.

We move fast, test aggressively, and continuously iterate on creative performance. Our focus is not on aesthetics alone, but on producing video content that converts and scales profitably.

We operate as a small, high performance team built around speed, ownership, and results.


Role Overview

We are hiring an AI Video Producer who specializes in generating high quality video content using AI tools such as VEO3, Kling, Heygen, and similar platforms.

You will be responsible for translating creative briefs into raw video assets by crafting effective prompts, iterating on outputs, and delivering production ready footage for our YouTube ad campaigns.

This role requires strong prompting skills, creative intuition, and the ability to consistently produce high quality outputs at scale.

You will work closely with creative strategists, editors, and AI workflows to bring ad concepts to life efficiently.


Key Responsibilities

Craft high quality prompts for VEO3, Kling, Heygen, and similar AI video tools to generate compelling video clips.

Produce raw video footage that aligns with creative briefs and direct response messaging.

Iterate on AI generated outputs to refine quality, consistency, and performance.

Translate written scripts and concepts into visual scenes using AI tools.

Collaborate with creative strategists and editors to ensure alignment on direction and deliverables.

Stay up to date with the latest AI video tools, prompting techniques, and workflows.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality.

Optimize workflows to increase output efficiency and scalability.


Qualifications and Requirements

Experience using AI video tools such as VEO, Kling, Heygen, Runway, or similar.

Strong prompting ability with a clear understanding of how to control output quality and style.

Good visual sense and understanding of storytelling, pacing, and scene composition.

Ability to follow creative briefs and translate them into accurate visual outputs.

Experience working in a fast paced, performance driven environment.

Highly self directed with strong attention to detail.

Comfortable working with iterative workflows and rapid testing cycles.

Basic understanding of direct response marketing is a strong advantage.


Preferred Skills and Bonuses

Experience producing video creatives for YouTube or paid social ads.

Understanding of direct response frameworks and ad structures.

Experience working with ecommerce brands.

Familiarity with AI workflow automation and tools.

Experience collaborating with editors and creative teams.


What We Offer

Fully remote position.

Consistent workload with ongoing projects.

Opportunity to work with cutting edge AI tools.

Fast paced environment with rapid learning.

Clear growth path as the agency scales.

Performance driven culture focused on output and results.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Accountant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for a detail-oriented Accountant to support our client with day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, and reconciliation processes within NetSuite. If you have strong experience managing financial data, ensuring accuracy across accounts, and working within a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes within NetSuite
  • Prepare and record journal entries, including accruals and adjustments
  • Perform bank and credit card reconciliations and resolve discrepancies
  • Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts to ensure accuracy
  • Support month-end and year-end close processes
  • Generate financial reports and assist with basic financial analysis
  • Review transactions for accuracy, completeness, and compliance
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify financial data and resolve issues
  • Ensure financial records are organized, accurate, and audit-ready within NetSuite


Who We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Minimum 3+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience supporting US-based clients or working in a BPO/outsourcing environment is preferred
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite and proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 1,200 - 1,600 , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.


The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.


Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.


As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping.


As part of Zoolatech’s distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery.


By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity.


Responsibilities


  • Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems
  • Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang
  • Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation
  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams
  • Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly
  • Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies
  • Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture


Skills Required

  • Strong commercial experience with Golang
  • Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS
  • Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services
  • Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills
  • Good communication skills and ability to work independently
  • English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python
  • Familiarity with MongoDB, Elasticsearch, GraphQL, or JVM languages
  • Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)

This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.

To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.

Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Oracle PCM Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Oracle PCM Architect em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Auxis

Auxis is a U.S.-founded consulting and business outsourcing firm (est. 1997) that helps organizations optimize and transform their operations. We specialize in areas such as technology, finance, human resources, automation, and digital transformation.


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Oracle PCM Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of profitability and cost management solutions within the Oracle EPM Cloud ecosystem.

This role requires a strong mix of functional finance knowledge + technical EPM expertise, with ownership over solution architecture and client-facing delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end solution design and architecture for Oracle PCM implementations
  • Define cost allocation models, driver-based costing, and profitability frameworks
  • Work closely with finance stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable solutions
  • Oversee data integrations, calculations, and model performance optimization
  • Ensure best practices in metadata design, hierarchies, and dimensional modeling
  • Support and guide teams during month-end and planning cycles
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across data, calculations, and reporting
  • Act as a technical leader and mentor for junior team members


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience with Oracle EPM, including strong exposure to PCM
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Cost allocation methodologies
  • Profitability analysis frameworks
  • Financial modeling and reporting
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Oracle PCMCS / EPCM
  • Smart View
  • Data Integration / Data Management
  • Metadata and hierarchy design


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in consulting or managed services environments
  • Exposure to multi-client / multi-project delivery
  • Oracle EPM certifications (nice to have)


Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and finance stakeholders
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment


Work Expectations

  • Support North American business hours when required
  • Flexibility during planning and financial cycles
  • Ownership of delivery quality and SLAs
